api_db.title: API + Database
api_db.intro: Store IAM credentials encrypted in the database and send via the SES HTTPS API.

steps.title: Create an IAM user with SES permissions
paragraphs: Create a user for programmatic access with an SES-sending policy (AmazonSESFullAccess for testing, or scoped to ses:SendRawEmail, ses:GetSendQuota, ses:GetSendStatistics).

steps.title: Verify identities and mind the sandbox
paragraphs: New accounts start in the SES sandbox — you can only send to verified addresses. Verify sender and recipient in the region you pick below, or sends fail as unverified.

steps.title: Paste keys in Database mode
paragraphs: Set Credential Storage to Database, enter your Access Key ID and Secret Access Key, pick the region, then save.

api_wp_config.title: API + wp-config.php
api_wp_config.intro: Define AWS constants in wp-config.php so secrets stay out of the database.

steps.title: Add constants to wp-config.php
paragraphs: Copy the defines from the connection card (WP Config mode): BOOLEANSMTP_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, BOOLEANSMTP_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, BOOLEANSMTP_AWS_REGION.

steps.title: IAM user and SES permissions
paragraphs: Create IAM keys with SES-sending permissions, same as Database mode — but paste them only into wp-config.php. Don't define the constants empty; that overrides database credentials.

steps.title: Save the connection
paragraphs: Set Credential Storage to WP Config, complete Sender Settings and region, then save. No secrets are written to the database.

smtp_db.title: SMTP + Database
smtp_db.intro: Send through SES SMTP endpoints with credentials stored encrypted in the database.

steps.title: SMTP credentials in SES
paragraphs: Create SMTP credentials in SES (or compatible IAM SMTP credentials) — distinct from your console login.

steps.title: Region and host:port
paragraphs: Pick the region where identities are verified, then match the host:port — 587 for STARTTLS or 465 for SSL.

steps.title: Database mode
paragraphs: Set Credential Storage to Database, enter region, host:port, SMTP username and password, then save.

smtp_wp_config.title: SMTP + wp-config.php
smtp_wp_config.intro: Define SMTP host, port, region, and credentials as constants — nothing sensitive touches the database.

steps.title: Copy SMTP constants
paragraphs: In WP Config mode, copy the generated BOOLEANSMTP_AWS_SES_SMTP_* defines and fill in your values.

steps.title: Match region and endpoint
paragraphs: Host, port, and encryption must match the SES region where identities are verified — 587 TLS or 465 SSL.

steps.title: Save without DB secrets
paragraphs: Set Credential Storage to WP Config, delivery to SMTP, complete Sender Settings, then save.
